prompt:
Build a dense, game-ready low-poly car with readable silhouette, lights, bumpers, wheel hubs and a spoiler. All attached details must retain their world transforms after parenting.

Build a low-poly game-ready car. The four wheels must be symmetric around the body and parented to it; preserve every requested transform.

In Blender, create exactly these labelled objects on a ground plane.
Use the requested primitive, location, and material name for each.
Add a camera and a light, save the .blend, then render a PNG.
